probe_assessment: The cold read mostly held up. The purpose and public API correctly captured the pipeline, return shapes, retries, sidecars, and keep-column write. One purpose summary compresses the keep rule into density even though the code has a duration-independent absolute count leg and a short-video count leg. The SDK stumble is genuine: this module cannot establish the installed google-genai version's exact Client().models.generate_content and config contract without external SDK documentation. The duration_min comment is stale, but the live seconds / 60.0 expression and seconds > SHORT_VIDEO_MIN_S > 0 condition resolve the intended denominator from the file. The chunk-ID concern is resolved by one list and append order. The boundary wording is an imprecise probe summary rather than a trap because the function documents and implements start-based half-open membership.

incidental_notes.quote: except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - retry SDK + JSON-parse errors alike
incidental_notes.note: The broad catch retries every exception, including programming errors, as if it were a transient SDK or JSON failure. The error is eventually re-raised as TriageError, so this is not swallowed, but non-transient faults can be obscured until retries finish.
